I flew with the U.S. Navy Blue Angels, pulled 7.5 g's, and came home with one big question: How does lift actually work? So of course I built a wind tunnel to learn the science of flight, bust some common myths, and find the real answer to what keeps planes in the air—even when they’re upside down. 

References: https://sites.google.com/view/be-smart-how-lift-works/home

I could not have done these awesome wind tunnel experiments without the hard work of Jerrod H and his incredible 3D printable wind tunnel design. If you'd like to make your own for STEM education, files are available for free at this link: https://www.printables.com/model/849713-modular-wind-tunnel-for-stem-education/files
